name: Marriage
source:
Sanae and Toru are childhood friends who live next door. They were very close friend at a young age, but as of lately there have been signs of mental retardation in Toru.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
早苗和彻是住在隔壁的青梅竹马。小时候，他们是非常要好的朋友，但最近彻似乎出现了智力发育迟缓的迹象。
